title: Check a photo
verdict_info_not_compared: Seal is valid — photo not compared yet
warn_auto_time: Automatic time was off on the phone
warn_clock_skew: The phone clock was {n} min off satellite time
warn_software_key: Software key — lower trust (normal on Android 7–8 and on emulators)
info_no_location: No location — the time and the photo are still covered by the seal
check_seal_bad: The seal does not match: the code or the information was changed
check_not_compared: Choose the photo you received to compare its content
check_image_maybe: The photo differs slightly from its seal (difference {d}/64)
check_image_mismatch: The photo does not match its seal (difference {d}/64)
check_content_c2pa: The original file's content is unchanged
device_unknown: Real device not confirmed yet — needs the original file
proves_l1: The details shown here are exactly as key {id} sealed them, and the picture matches what was sealed
proves_not_device: It does not show which app or phone made the seal: confirming a real device needs the original file
proves_screen: A photo taken of a screen showing a fake picture cannot be detected
address_note: The address on the stamp was looked up by the phone from these coordinates
pick_photo: Choose a photo or the original file
error_read: This file could not be read
error_too_big: This file is larger than 40 MB. Choose a smaller copy of the photo
no_code: No CameraStamp code found in this photo
too_old: This browser is too old to check photos. Update it, or open this page in a recent Chrome, Safari or Firefox.
footer_app: Checked with CameraStamp — get the app
attested_unknown: Google attestation data: copy date unknown
l2_none: No C2PA data in this file (a chat app may have removed it)
l2_invalid: The original file's signature is not valid: the file was changed
l2_signature_ok: The original file is signed and unchanged
l2_untrusted_note: Other C2PA tools will say "signer not trusted": each phone has its own key, which no list can hold
l2_chain_ok: Key certified by Google's Android attestation
l2_revoked: A certificate in the chain was revoked by Google
l2_app_dev: Made by a test build of CameraStamp
l2_app_bad: Not made by the CameraStamp app
l2_level_hw: Key kept in the phone's secure hardware
l2_level_sw: Software key — the phone's attestation is software-only, as on Android 7–8 and emulators: lower trust
l2_boot_bad: The phone's bootloader is unlocked or its system modified
l2_binding_bad: The file was signed by a different key than the certified one
l2_real_device: Sealed by a key in the secure hardware of a real device (an Android phone)
l2_qr_link: This QR was sealed by the same key, kept in a real device's secure hardware
l2_qr_same_key: This QR was sealed by the same key as this original file
l2_qr_other_key: This QR was sealed by a different key than the original file
l2_tsa: Existed no later than {time} — confirmed by {tsa}
l2_video: Video: duration {s} s, data from its first second
error_too_large_image: This photo has too many pixels to check in the browser. Choose a smaller copy (for example, the one a chat app sent)
notice_other_seal: This photo carries a different seal than the link you opened. The result below is for the photo's own seal
privacy_history: The link you opened, with its coordinates, stays in this browser's history
error_unsupported: This file type can't be checked here. Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo
verdict_too_flat: Details valid — this photo is too dark or flat to compare
check_too_flat: Too dark or flat to compare: the seal and its details were checked, the picture itself was not
verdict_flat_mismatch: This photo isn't dark or flat — the seal belongs to a different photo
check_flat_mismatch: The seal was made for a dark or flat photo, but this photo shows detail
l2_app_unregistered: App signature not yet registered on this page — not confirmed as the CameraStamp app
l2_app_unknown: The phone's attestation does not name the app (normal on Android 7)
l2_no_seal: This file's C2PA data has no CameraStamp seal
l2_error: Couldn't read this file here — try another browser or a computer
verdict_l2_bad: The original file's seal can't be trusted
error_too_big_video: This video is larger than 100 MB and can't be checked here
verdict_green_sub: Sealed by key {id} — which app and phone made it is not confirmed
proves_small_edits: Noticeable changes to the picture are detected; tiny edits may not be (the original file proves every byte)
info_location_withheld: Location not included in this seal
verdict_code_not_in_photo: No readable code in this photo — compared using the seal from the link only
check_code_not_in_photo: This photo's own code was not read, so nothing in the photo ties it to this seal
verdict_maybe_cropped: This photo may have been cropped
check_geometry_mismatch: The photo's shape or the code's position doesn't match the sealed photo: it may have been cropped or framed (for example, a screenshot)
verdict_geometry_unknown: Couldn't check the framing of this photo
check_geometry_unknown: The code in this photo is tilted or distorted, so its framing couldn't be compared with the sealed photo — it may have been cropped
verdict_l2_resaved: Re-saved or edited after sealing — the picture still matches its seal
